enterURL: enter the URL of a series first
busy: a series is loading or a download is running
updateUnavailable: one-click update isn't available for this copy
updateBusy: the update is already in progress
updateWaitDownload: wait for the download to finish, or cancel it, before updating
updateMeanwhile: a download started meanwhile: finish or cancel it, then update again
updateRestart: Updated to {{version}}, but couldn't restart; open Manga Downloader again
chapterMissing: chapter {{index}} is not in the list
partsVolumes: "parts" isn't a Volumes value: pick Merged under Pack as
filtersChanged: the language or scanlator changed: reload the series first
noVolumes: the site doesn't say which volume these chapters are in; give the volumes as chapter ranges instead, e.g. "1-7/8-16"
